title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Let them pick the last drill
hook: What would your players pick if you let them choose?
intro: Energy is low, and so is focus.
statement: A small choice gives kids a reason to finish strong.
q1: Do you let the team vote on the last drill —
q2: or keep the plan in your hands?
q3: What do kids learn when their choice counts?
t1: Both can work. But practice ends better
t2: when kids feel some of it is theirs.
ctaLines: A vote. A captain's pick. A favorite game.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What would your players pick if you let them choose?
Practice is almost over. Energy is low, and so is focus.
A small choice gives kids a reason to finish strong.
Let them choose or stick to the plan. Every team is different.
Do players ever choose? Share your habit in the comments.
